_about: Class overview content for the class pages (overview, party value, mechanics, opener, mistakes, gear, patch history). Hand-edited. Skill names must match data/skills.json or a stigma in data/stigma_db.json so the hover cards work. Gear notes are Korean endgame advice from the Sep 2026 optimizer guides unless marked otherwise.
gearCommon: Korean endgame advice (Sep 2026 optimizer guides). Gear stat lines: Damage Boost, Crit Damage Boost and Double Chance first on every piece, then Attack and your key passives. Bracelet: Justice and Space instead of Freedom and Death for PvE (the new raid's Accuracy/Crit requirements came out low). Pet Genus slots 3 and 9: Double Chance; slots 2, 5, 8: Attack Bonus or Max Attack; the rest Boss Attack. Pantheon: Illusion 51 / Wisdom 101 is the realistic top. Global launches with fewer stats and cards, so treat these as the direction to build toward.

gladiator.glance: Two-skill melee: the Overhead Slam → Rending Blow cancel is the class.
gladiator.summary: A greatsword fighter whose damage comes from two skills that cancel into each other. Overhead Slam (plus its Upward Strike chain) and Rending Blow made up about two-thirds of the damage in the Aug 26–30 Korean dummy logs. Everything else (stigmas, buffs, Ruinous Blow) exists to make those two hit harder and faster. It can also off-tank.
brings: Passive: every Block gives you and the party +5.4% PvE damage for 20 s. Doesn't stack with a Templar's Fury, so the higher one wins.
Stigma level 10 adds Predation for the party for 20 s.
Wounded: the enemy's Attack -10% for 10 s, and you get +10% PvE damage.
Raises Enmity. The Battle tank stigma build turns that into a real off-tank.
core: Pressing Rending Blow right after Overhead Slam cuts Overhead Slam's recovery. The Aug 26 patch brought it back. Hold the macro and the Overhead Slam key and the cancel happens by itself.
Ruinous Blow gives +20% PvE damage, +100 Crit and +15% status chance for 20 s. Open every pull with it, and recast it on cooldown (45 s).
Sword Aura Rampage only hits staggered targets. Placed directly under Rending Blow, its cancel fires on its own whenever the boss is staggered.
Wave Armor 10 makes Experienced Counterstrike ×1.5, Wave Armor 15 makes Murderous Burst ×1.5, and Lunge Stance 15 makes Identify Weakness ×1.5. That's why those stigmas go to 15–20 first.
opener: Lunge Stance, Zikel's Blessing, Wave Armor
Ruinous Blow (Prepare for Battle)
Hold the macro and mash (or hold) the Overhead Slam key. Rage Burst fires from under it
Recast Ruinous Blow every 45 s. Use Leaping Slam to close gaps
good: Simple core: two skills carry the damage
Can tank in a pinch (Battle tank stigma build)
hard: Front melee: Front Damage Boost is your stat, so stay in front of the boss
A hit-count class: Combat Speed, FPS and ping matter a lot
Top numbers need fast Overhead Slam presses (the one-key layout avoids that)
mistakes: Putting buffs in a second macro line: that cost 5–6% of Overhead Slam hits in an Aug 12 test
Skipping the Ruinous Blow opener (Prepare for Battle is +20% PvE damage)
Leveling anything before Overhead Slam and Rending Blow reach 20
Expecting Experienced Counterstrike and a Templar's Fury to stack: only the higher one counts

templar.glance: Main tank whose damage runs through Judgment, opened by shield attacks.
templar.summary: The sword-and-shield main tank. Since the Aug 26 rework, Judgment (no cooldown) opens for 2 s after any shield attack. Kanon's guide puts over 60% of Templar damage on Judgment alone. Templar also brings the party's best defensive tools and a damage buff that triggers when you block.
brings: Passive: every Block gives you and the party +5.5% PvE damage for 20 s (doesn't stack with a Gladiator's Experienced Counterstrike).
On Block, Debilitate the target: Defense -25% for 5 s.
Stigma: a shield worth 41% of Max HP on you and nearby party members.
Stigma: take half the damage a party member is hit with, for 6 s.
core: Warding Strike, Shield Smite and Doom Shield are shield attacks: each opens Judgment for 2 s. That's why they share Judgment's macro line.
Hold Vicious Strike (basic attack) with the macro and it cancels straight into Judgment. The Sep 16 patch killed the old Pummel → Judgment cancel.
A fully charged Punishment gives Executor: +200 Accuracy and +20% PvE damage for 20 s. Charge it before the pull and keep it up.
Doom Shield resets Annihilate, so Annihilate → Doom Shield → Annihilate is the top-end burst.
opener: Noble Armor, Battlefield Banner, Empyrean Lord's Punishment
Fully charge Punishment (Executor)
Rush in, hold Vicious Strike + the macro + the Punishment key
Annihilate → Doom Shield → Annihilate. Shield of Protection every ~20 s or on boss crowd control
good: The tankiest class, with party shields and damage sharing
Judgment makes the damage plan simple
hard: You hold aggro and face the boss, so positioning and Taunt are on you
Damage is concentrated in Judgment: if its level or its windows lag, damage drops
The Sep 16 cancel nerf made the old macros worse
mistakes: Still using the Pummel → Judgment cancel (dead since Sep 16)
Letting Executor fall off instead of recharging Punishment
Leveling other skills before Judgment and Pummel reach 20
Running Fury and a Gladiator's Experienced Counterstrike for the same party buff: they don't stack

assassin.glance: Back-attack burst: build Insignias, detonate them, chain Heart Gore on crits.
assassin.summary: A dagger melee built around Insignia stacks and crits. Ambush, Heart Gore and Savage Fang engrave Insignias on the target. Insignia Explosion detonates up to 5 stacks, and Heart Gore fires again every time you crit. Illusive Clone removes Heart Gore's cooldown for 10 s, which is the burst window. You want to be behind the boss.
brings: Passive: the target's Defense -12% and Status Effect Resist -11% for 10 s when you hit a staggered or impact-stunned target.
Stigma: an AoE hit that blinds NPCs 100% of the time.
Passive: Poison damage over time, plus less incoming healing on the target (PvP).
core: Ambush from behind engraves 2, Heart Gore's option 2 engraves 1, Savage Fang engraves 5. Insignia Explosion's damage and stun chance scale with the stack count (max 5).
Heart Gore can only fire after you land a crit. Option 5 (skill level 16) resets its cooldown on every crit, so crit chance = Heart Gore count.
10 s with no Heart Gore cooldown and +20% extra damage. Press Swift Contract first, because its attack-speed buff shortens Clone's animation.
Holding the Storm Rampage key during stagger cancels into Heart Gore faster and keeps Illusive Clone up longer (Sep 30 guide).
opener: Swift Contract → Illusive Clone
Savage Fang → Triniel's Dagger (the Dagger only cuts cooldowns already running)
Hold Quick Slice + the macro, plus the Storm Rampage key in stagger windows
Stay behind the boss. Use Shadowstep or Throw Shadowblade to get back there
good: The highest burst of any class
Simple macro: one line does it
hard: Needs back attacks (Back Damage Boost): you lose a lot when stuck in front
Attack-speed breakpoints matter (April test: 88.1% and 92%; avoid 99.9–100.7%)
Patches change the cancels often
mistakes: Buffs in the macro: low Heart Gore counts usually mean buffs in the macro or a missing Savage Roar
Taking Ambush option 5 (+2 uses): it slows the motion and lowered damage
Dropping Heart Gore option 2 for lifesteal: damage drops, so let Ambush's lifesteal cover sustain
Pressing Triniel's Dagger before Savage Fang

ranger.glance: Bow sniper: Marking Shot crits, Deadshot charges and the Tempest Shot cancel.
ranger.summary: A bow DPS that plays from range on a two-line macro (the most Ranger can use without losing hits). Marking Shot gives Precision (+300 Crit), and Deadshot hits 35% harder with it. Slow and Root effects make Burst Arrow, Explosive Arrow and the Rooting Eye passive hit harder. Few actives need to reach 20, so passives carry a lot.
brings: Root (100% on NPCs) for adds and positioning.
Slow, which also powers Burst Arrow and Explosive Arrow (+20% to Slowed or Rooted targets).
Stigma: a 15 s orb that shoots and heals you.
core: Marking Shot gives +300 Crit for 10 s and Deadshot +35% damage. Cast it standing still, and refresh it with ~2 s left.
Tempest Shot sits at the top of a different line from the short-cooldown arrows. That gives more Tempest Shot hits (~+3%). Arrow Scattershot directly under it catches the stagger cancel.
Burst Arrow only fires on Slowed or Rooted targets. Explosive Arrow and Rooting Eye hit harder on them.
Deadshot has 3 charge levels. It's held on its own key next to the macro.
opener: Marking Shot (standing) → Gale Arrow (+7% Combat Speed)
Vaizel's Authority and Bow of Blessing for burst
Hold Snipe + the macro + Deadshot
Supporting Fire on cooldown
hard: Two-line macro, and buffs in a third line drop Snipe below 16/min
Hit-count sensitive: checks like Tempest Shot 250+/min tell you if something is off
Moving while casting Marking Shot costs damage
mistakes: Putting buffs in the macro (Snipe falls under 16–18/min)
Tempest Shot in the same line as Drill Dart: the cancel is lost
Casting Marking Shot while moving
Skipping Shackling Arrow and Snare Shot's move-cast option (+2–3%)

gear.passives: Focused Eye and Hunter's Resolve on gear (a recent buff widened the gap), then Crit in leftover gear slots

sorcerer.glance: Ranged nuker: fully charged Hellfire after Delayed Explosion, plus ground AoEs.
sorcerer.summary: A spellbook caster with the highest ceiling among ranged classes. It's also the least forgiving: low HP, slow animations and ground AoEs that miss when the boss moves. Damage is spread over many skills (Hellfire ~21%, Fire Wall ~16%, Blaze ~13–16%, Bittercold Wind ~13–16%, Cold Storm ~10%), so missing any one of them hurts. It relies on cooldown reduction more than any other class.
brings: Stigma: ground AoE that slows and roots. Two Sorcerers' Cold Storms don't stack.
Stigma: ground AoE with Embers damage over time.
Option 3: +20% PvE damage for 5 s when it lands (you only).
core: Delayed Explosion makes the target take +15% damage from you (+10% more at stigma 20) for 4 s. Land your fully charged Hellfire inside that window.
Blaze only hits targets with Fire Mark. Flame Arrow's option 4 (skill level 12) applies Fire Mark, and option 5 (16) resets Blaze's cooldown. In KR/TW, the Sep 16 patch made Fire Mark proc 100%.

Wish of Concentration option 5 cuts all cooldowns by 10 s. Firestorm option 4 cuts Hellfire by 2 s per fireball, and Blaze option 5 cuts Wish of Concentration. Korean players aim for 43% cooldown reduction.
+20% Fire and Water Attack for 10 s. Stigma level 10 makes Robe of Flame ×1.5, your one key passive.
opener: Element Enhancement → Delayed Explosion
Fully charged Hellfire
Hold Flame Arrow + the macro (Fire Wall and Cold Storm drop from the macro)

spiritmaster.glance: Summoner: four spirits on timers feed Elemental Fusion and Jointstrikes.
spiritmaster.summary: An orb caster who fights with four spirits. Each spirit's skill gives you an element. At 4 stacks you get Four Elements and can fire Elemental Fusion. Jointstrikes add a spirit follow-up on top of your own hit. The Ancient Spirit (30 s) is the burst window. Part of the damage comes from the spirits themselves, which Kanon notes may make ping matter a little less than for other classes.
brings: Taunts (+3,750 Enmity) and can hold adds.
Damage over time, and the target deals 10% less damage to you.
The target takes +10% damage from your spirit for 20 s.
core: Every spirit skill adds an element. At 4 you can fire Elemental Fusion (mash it on its own key). The Ancient Spirit grants Four Elements every time it uses its skill.
The four summons share a 15 s cooldown pattern and get their own macro line. Water → Earth first keeps skills from being eaten and the Fire Spirit up.
Summon the Ancient Spirit, then fully charge Destructive Attack 3–4 s later. Since Sep 10 its spirit follow-up fires instantly.
Keep Cold Shock's 5-stack attack buff running. Fight from about 3 m.
opener: Buffs, then Earth Tremor at 4–5 stacks and Element Unification at full
Summon: Ancient Spirit
3–4 s later: fully charged Jointstrike: Destructive Attack
Hold Cold Shock + the macro and mash Elemental Fusion
good: Spirits keep dealing damage while you move
hard: Lots of moving parts: spirit timers, Fusion stacks, Ancient window
Spirit skills can get eaten if the summon order is wrong
Ground and positioning rules (about 3 m) for best results
mistakes: Summoning in the wrong order (Water → Earth first)
Using Destructive Attack outside the Ancient Spirit window
Putting Elemental Fusion in the macro instead of mashing it
Letting Cold Shock's 5-stack buff drop

cleric.glance: Healer with real damage: Chain of Torment opens Condemnation, Earth Punishment makes it crit.
cleric.summary: A mace healer whose damage matters in Korean raids. Condemnation (no cooldown) only hits targets with Chain of Torment. Earth Punishment makes Condemnation always crit. Cleric's attack speed caps at 94.4% while other classes reach about 121.6%, so Cleric chases cooldown reduction instead and can afford a second macro line.
brings: Stigma: +10.5% PvE damage and damage tolerance for the party (doesn't stack with a Chanter's Undefeated Mantra).

Stigma: raise a fallen party member, invincible for 3–5 s.
Stigma: +20% PvE damage tolerance for the party for 10 s.
core: Condemnation only hits targets with Chain of Torment, which is why Chain sits in the same macro line.
With Earth Punishment on the target, Condemnation always crits. Earth Punishment leads the macro line.
Cleric attack speed caps at 94.4%. Anything past it is wasted, so aim for 32.6% cooldown reduction instead.
Bolt and heals stay off the macro so a charge never delays a heal. Debilitating Mark only when the party is hurting.
opener: Light of Protection / buffs
Earth Punishment → Chain of Torment → Condemnation (from the macro)
Hold Earth's Retribution + the macro + Lightning Strike Scattershot
Heal and Bolt by hand

chanter.glance: Support melee: party buffs plus Dark Crush, opened by ranged skills.
chanter.summary: A staff fighter who buffs the whole party and still deals solid damage. Its mantras and Power of the Storm are some of the strongest party buffs in the game. Its damage runs through Dark Crush, which opens for 2 s after ranged skills since the Aug 26 rework. It can also cover heals and shields as a battle healer.
brings: Toggle: +10.5% PvE damage and damage tolerance for nearby party members (doesn't stack with a Cleric's Light of Protection).
Party +20% Combat Speed and -10% cooldowns for 10 s (you: -20%). Blocked by a Cleric's Earth's Blessing.
Enemy PvE damage tolerance -5.4% (doesn't stack with a Cleric's Chain of Torment).
Party heal + cleanse, with a heal over time.
core: Spinning Strike, Impactful Crush and Marchutan's Wrath are ranged skills: each opens Dark Crush for 2 s. Spinning Strike also stacks +15% Crit Damage (×2).
Toggles never go in a macro
Undefeated Mantra and Sprint Mantra are toggles. A second press switches them off, so keep them on their own keys.
Hold Gust Rampage with the macro: its stagger cancel lowers its cooldown and keeps damage flowing.
Stack Guardian Blessing on top of Power of the Storm (both 2 min since Sep 16) so it's never forgotten.
opener: Undefeated Mantra and Sprint Mantra on
Power of the Storm + Guardian Blessing
Hold Onslaught + the macro + Gust Rampage
Recuperation when the party needs it
good: Huge party value: damage, speed and cooldown buffs
Can heal, cleanse and shield (battle healer)
hard: Buff management on top of a damage rotation
Several buffs clash with Cleric buffs, so coordinate
Dark Crush windows collide if the macro is built wrong
mistakes: Putting toggle mantras in the macro (the macro switches them off)
Stacking Spinning Strike, Impactful Crush and Marchutan's Wrath so their Dark Crush windows overlap
Running Power of the Storm with a Cleric's Earth's Blessing active (blocked)
Still slotting Marchutan's Wrath out of habit: it's no longer required

roadmap: Go through MSQ to 45 and do some of these while at it or come back later:
1. Sealed Dungeons - these give daevanation crystals for your board + skill points
2. Regional Quests - give daevanation crystals + gear
3. Feathers - scrolls for leveling your amulet + stamina + amplification stone shards
4. Strongholds - scrolls for leveling your belt
5. Rifting - sealed dungeons & strongholds in enemy faction (PvP is togglable)
Go straight into the abyss to grab feathers and your weekly quests
Buy a ring once you have enough abyss points
Finish any side stuff you haven't completed (Feathers are 188 of them)
All pieces to +10 and Manastones (should be around ~1400 score) enough for Vakron Sky Island (2* exploration dungeon)
IF it's like KR/TW, Go to the Rift every 3 hours for extra strongholds and dungeons.
Do Vakron until you get the full set. IF you have 7/8 pieces and far from pity, do the expedition version instead to hit pity.
Get all Green Cards (Blues are a bonus)
Level up your belt and amulet to squeeze some extra gear score and get some more bulk and damage (should be around ~1920 score)
Farm Deus till you get all blue cards with ideally some of your main skills to +16 (should be around ~2190 Score)
Farm Kromede to finish your Accessories
If you are not able to craft the Splendent Dark Dragon Lord weapon then just go for the Kromede weapon or something of similar ilvl until you can replace it
Farm Ferocious Horn Den to finish your Guard and Armor pieces (Armor will be used all of season 1). All to +10. (Should be around ~2560).
Ideally stage 4 but 3 is fine. Farm this till you get all Yellow Cards with the proper skills for your class to hit level 20 on those skills in preparation for Ludra
buffs: The first 2 buffs for chanter and cleric do not stack. Chanter one takes priority
Meta comp takes both and Cleric takes off Light of Protection for more heals/shields/self damage.
Ressurects all fallen party members and grants invincibility for 3-11 seconds after resurrection
This is not an extra res. It just saves you stones
15% Change to restore 615-677 HP on landing an attack (increases amount healed by 200% when hp is 50% or lower.
